item.title: 🟠 Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.

CISA has added CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to its KEV catalog after the Ivanti VPN flaws were chained in zero-day attacks.

The post Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain appeared first on SecurityWeek.



Source: SecurityWeek  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: <1h

item.title: 🔴 New VOLTA Infostealer Uses Claude, Gemini, and Kimi AI to Rank Victims by Financial Value
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — review monitoring and incident-response readiness.
Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a new Windows infostealer malware called VOLTA-AUTODOXER (aka VOLTA) that makes use of a large language model (LLM) to rank a victim's stolen data by their monetization value. Like other typical stealer families, VOLTA is equipped to harvest passwords and cookies from Chromium-based web browsers; data from Outlook profiles and Slack workspaces;

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 2h

item.title: 🟠 Chainalysis Confirms Intrusion Into Internal Tools and Exposure of Customer Identity Data
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.
